put.description: Assigns a unique username to the user during onboarding.

409.description: Username taken (USERNAME_TAKEN) or flow not at this step (INVALID_STEP)

429.description: More than 10 checks per flow or 30 per IP in 15 minutes (USERNAME_CHECK_LIMIT), with Retry-After

put.description: Finalizes the onboarding with the login password, the 6-digit transaction PIN and acceptedLegalDocuments: the Terms and Privacy versions shown to the user (from GET /api/legal/terms and /api/legal/privacy). The user then signs in through /api/auth/login with email and password.

400.description: PIN not 6 digits, or password not 8-72 characters / over 72 UTF-8 bytes (VALIDATION_FAILED)

409.description: Flow not at this step (INVALID_STEP), or email/username taken by another sign-up meanwhile (ALREADY_TAKEN), or acceptedLegalDocuments are not the active Terms/Privacy versions (LEGAL_VERSION_OUTDATED; nothing was saved, reload the texts and retry)

put.description: Updates the user's full name in the onboarding flow.

post.description: For Google accounts, which are created without a PIN. Payments and transfers answer 403 PIN_NOT_SET until it is set.

409.description: PIN already set (PIN_ALREADY_SET); use the change-PIN flow

get.description: Retrieves all transfers of all users (admin only).

post.description: Moves money from one of the caller's cards to any card in the same currency, confirmed with the caller's PIN. A 2% commission is added to the debit.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. UUID); a retry with the same key returns the first result

400.description: Validation failed, same card, currency mismatch, or Idempotency-Key header blank or over 255 characters (INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY)

403.description: Wrong PIN (INVALID_PIN), or current Terms/Privacy not accepted (LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED)

429.description: Too many wrong PINs; PIN checks locked for 15 minutes (PIN_LOCKED); see Retry-After

409.description: Insufficient balance for amount plus commission, or card busy (retry with the same Idempotency-Key)

422.description: Idempotency-Key already used for a different request

file.description: The image file to upload (PNG, JPG, etc.)

post.description: Needs the current PIN. Sends a 6-digit code to the new address and another to the current one. The email changes only after POST /api/profile/email/confirm with both codes (within 10 minutes); the old address is then notified.

200.description: Codes sent to the new and the current address

400.description: Not an email address or PIN not 6 digits (VALIDATION_FAILED)

403.description: Wrong PIN (INVALID_PIN) or no PIN set yet (PIN_NOT_SET)

409.description: Email already taken (EMAIL_TAKEN); still counts toward the cooldown and daily limit

429.description: Code requested within the last minute (OTP_SEND_TOO_FREQUENT) or more than 5 changes today (EMAIL_CHANGE_LIMIT) or too many wrong PINs (PIN_LOCKED); see Retry-After

post.description: Needs the code sent to the new address (otp) and the one sent to the current address (currentEmailOtp). Switches the account to the new email and signs out every device; log in again with the new email.

400.description: A wrong code, either one (INVALID_OTP), or no pending change (OTP_EXPIRED)

429.description: Too many wrong codes; start again (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS)

post.description: Starts a payment flow between cards. Returns a Flow ID required for confirmation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. UUID); a retry with the same key returns the first result

400.description: Invalid payment request (non-positive amount, malformed card number), or Idempotency-Key header blank or over 255 characters (INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY)

404.description: Card not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Insufficient balance, or card busy (retry with the same Idempotency-Key)

422.description: Idempotency-Key already used for a different request

post.description: Finalizes the payment using the Flow ID and user's secure PIN.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. UUID); a retry with the same key returns the first result

400.description: Validation failed (flow ID missing, PIN not 6 digits), or Idempotency-Key header blank or over 255 characters (INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY)

404.description: Payment flow not found or not owned by the caller

429.description: Too many wrong PINs; PIN checks locked for 15 minutes (PIN_LOCKED); see Retry-After

409.description: Payment already processed, insufficient balance, or busy (retry with the same Idempotency-Key)

422.description: Idempotency-Key already used for a different request

post.description: Verifies the One-Time Password sent to the user's email.
Starts the onboarding process by submitting an email and initiating a flow.

Records that the caller accepted the given Terms/Privacy versions (the ones listed in pendingLegalDocuments of GET /api/auth/me). Until every active document is accepted, transfers and payments answer 403 LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED. Accepting the same version again changes nothing.

409.description: A version is not the active one, or an active document is missing (LEGAL_VERSION_OUTDATED); nothing was recorded, load the documents again

post.description: Starts the PIN change process by sending an OTP to the authenticated user's email. Returns a Flow ID.

post.description: Updates the user's PIN after successful OTP verification. Requires the new PIN and its confirmation.

parameters.description: Unique identifier for the PIN change process

400.description: PINs do not match or invalid format

404.description: No such flow for this user

get.description: Returns every card in the system (admin only).

post.description: Issues a card in the chosen currency for the logged-in user. The full card number is in this response only; afterwards just the last four digits are shown.

Reads the refresh token from the pg_refresh cookie and rotates it: the old one stops working. Presenting an already rotated refresh token revokes the whole session. The request must carry an allowed Origin header.

200.description: New access token; the rotated refresh token is set as the cookie

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked (INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN), reused (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED), or from an origin that is not allowed (REFRESH_ORIGIN_REJECTED)

post.description: After Google sign-in the browser lands on FRONTEND_URL/oauth2/callback?code=... The frontend trades the code here, once, within 60 seconds, for the same tokens as /login. On failure it lands on ?error=email_not_verified | account_exists | account_locked | oauth_failed instead.

200.description: Signed in; a new device session was started

401.description: Code invalid, expired or already used (INVALID_OAUTH_CODE)

post.description: Revokes the session of the pg_refresh cookie and clears the cookie. Needs no access token and always succeeds, even without a valid cookie, but like a cookie refresh it must carry an allowed Origin header.

200.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared

post.description: İstifadəçi adı və şifrə ilə sistemə daxil olaraq JWT token əldə edir.
